_comment: coaching-trees-v1 batch file shape (docs/done/COACHING_TREES_PLAN.md §2.2). Copy to batch_<A|B|C>.json. The protégé's (or member's) 2026 team decides the batch. Persons are seed refs {table, team, role} from db/seed_clean_db.py (no names). Edge rule: the mentor was the protégé's boss on one staff (HC over any assistant, coordinator over a position coach on his side), NFL or college, >= 2 seasons summed over stints, or 1 season plus a source marked "mentorship": true; playing careers and peers don't count. >= 2 sources per edge, one medium/high, published on or before 2026-09-08. Only approved/edited entries load. trees.json (kind registry) holds {trees: [{key, label, root, parent, summary, evidence, review}], evidence}.

evidence.summary: What the source says, in your own words.
Second source; add "mentorship": true when it calls the tie a mentorship.
